intents.reason: The next pre-1.0 minor removes caller-supplied lexical import hints, requires exact Rust-authored declaration identities for style resolution, preserves analyzed-empty reachability as a closed-world result, and projects typed dialect-cycle evidence instead of a generic pass-unavailable blocker. It also moves custom-property diagnostics and module-interface joins onto the shared decoded, case-preserving property identity, revalidates deferred standard-property values after Salsa-fed var() substitution, replaces the merged bundler-host export map with typed class and ICSS-value namespaces plus source-anchored collision diagnostics, and adds a native build-snapshot digest that binds adapter cache decisions to content and engine-owned identities.

expectedRuntimeValueChanges.surface: OmenaBundlerHostResolveModuleResponseV0 export families, named exports, declarations, and collision diagnostics
expectedRuntimeValueChanges.reason: Bundler-host responses no longer merge emitted class tokens and ICSS values under one string key. Same-named exports remain available in separate typed families, flat named entries carry their family, and an anchored diagnostic reports that JavaScript cannot expose both through one flat binding.

expectedRuntimeValueChanges.reason: Query consumers now join declaration and var-reference facts by sealed custom-property keys, while public presentation carriers pair non-comparable authored text with the sealed key. Escape-equivalent references resolve, case-distinct names remain separate, and module-interface sets expose canonical key types instead of raw strings.
